payload.title: Wedding Destinations in November for Autumn or Spring
payload.meta_title: Wedding Destinations in November for Autumn or Spring
payload.audience: 30s, couples who are interested in destination weddings and luxury experiences, 150k+ AUD budget
payload.reader: An Australian couple in their 30s with AUD 150k or more to spend who are looking at a November date (often for leave late in the year or a long engagement ending before the summer holidays) and are deciding between a late autumn celebration in Europe, where the season is closing, and a spring or early summer wedding in the Pacific or Indian Ocean, where the wet or cyclone season is starting, and who want to know plainly what November is like in each place and what to ask before they put down a deposit.
payload.goal: Book a consultation with a Wedded Advisor (Speak with a Wedded Advisor).
payload.angle: November is a month of edges. In southern Europe it is the end of the season, with cooler, wetter days and venues that may already be closing for winter; across the tropics it is the start of the wet, monsoon or cyclone season; only New Zealand is in a plain late spring. Most November lists sell autumn colour or tropical sun and leave the timing out. This page gives 10 unranked places we plan in and have a live guide for, grouped by what November actually is there, with November weather quoted only from an official source that names the station and period, the trade-off said plainly, and two venue questions per place that turn it into a plan (is the venue still open on our date, where does the ceremony go in rain, what happens if a storm closes the airport).
must_include: Direct answer intro (2 to 3 sentences): November is late autumn in the northern hemisphere and spring or early summer in the southern, and in the tropics it marks the start of the wet, monsoon or cyclone season as Smartraveller and NWS describe it; New Zealand is the plain spring option. Then exactly 4 one-sentence takeaways: (1) who the ten are, by group; (2) Europe is late season, so cooler evenings and whether the venue is still open are the first things to settle; (3) Fiji, Mauritius and the Seychelles enter the cyclone or monsoon season Smartraveller describes from November, and Bali and Hawaii are inside their wet windows, so covered space and a buffer day belong in the booking; (4) choose on the trade-off you can live with. Write fresh: do not reuse March or August sentences.

Short 'How we chose these ten November destinations' section: only places we plan in and have a live guide for, unranked; the WMO care-when-comparing remark (reuse March fact_007 or fact_115). LINK comments here for the August and March sister pages (both drafts) and a LINK comment holding Punta Cana back: <!-- LINK: /destination-weddings/punta-cana-destination-wedding when live; add as an entry (Atlantic hurricane season ends 30 November per NHC) -->.

Group 1 'Autumn in the northern hemisphere' (5 entries, unranked): Greek islands -> /destinations/europe/greece (plus live island guides /destination-weddings/santorini-wedding, /destination-weddings/mykonos-wedding, /destination-weddings/wedding-in-crete; timing link /destination-weddings/best-time-to-get-married-in-greece); Amalfi Coast -> /destinations/europe/italy/amalfi-coast-wedding (timing link /destination-weddings/best-time-to-get-married-in-italy); French Riviera -> /destinations/europe/france; Portugal -> /destinations/europe/portugal; Hawaii -> /destination-weddings/getting-married-in-hawaii (said plainly to be northern tropics, so its November is the start of the heavier winter rains NWS describes, not a European autumn). Every European entry carries 'Is the venue open in November?' or an equivalent as one of its two venue questions; never state closing dates.

Group 2 'Spring and early summer in the southern hemisphere' (5 entries, unranked): New Zealand -> /destination-weddings/get-married-in-new-zealand; Mauritius -> /destination-weddings/mauritius-wedding; Seychelles -> /destination-weddings/getting-married-in-seychelles; Bali -> /destinations/asia/bali (timing link /destination-weddings/best-time-to-get-married-in-bali); Fiji -> /destinations/oceania/fiji. Fiji, Mauritius, the Seychelles and Bali state the cyclone, monsoon or wet season plainly, as Smartraveller words it, dated 'as at November 2026'. New Zealand and Fiji November summaries are labelled as one year only.

Same entry template as March for all 10: 'Why November' or 'The November trade-off' (one honest paragraph); 'November weather' quoted only from the official source naming station and period, linked at the claim, with fact markers; 'Questions for the venue' (two bullets); 'Our guide' link.
At-a-glance table in plain words: Destination | November conditions (as the source states, station named) | The trade-off. Values must match the entries exactly.

'What to plan for a November wedding abroad' section with short parts on late season openings in Europe (as a question to check, no dates), wet and cyclone season cover and a buffer day in the tropics, the one-line legal note linking /destination-weddings/weddings-abroad-where-can-you-legally-get-married and /expert-advice/symbolic-ceremony, and guests travelling from Australia. Public or school holidays only as a question to check, never with dates. The single body Wedded Advisor line goes here, from brand-facts 'Claims we can make' (e.g. 'One Wedded Advisor plans the venue, travel, vendors and payments anywhere in the world, as your single point of contact from start to finish. (Never mention room blocks or Wedded Privileges: deferred.)'). Also link /expert-advice/how-to-plan-a-destination-wedding, the November honeymoon page (if live), /magazine (UTM magnet) and Wedded Concierge secondary CTA, as in March.

FAQ (4 to 6 questions), e.g. Is November a good month to get married abroad? Where is warm for a wedding in November? Is November cyclone season in Fiji? Is November spring in New Zealand? Are European venues open in November? Then close 'Plan your November wedding with Wedded Concierge': one Wedded Advisor plans the venue, travel, vendors and payments as your single point of contact, and the fee is agreed in writing before any work begins; closing CTA with the anchor 'Wedded Concierge'.
avoid: Prices, 'From AUD' figures or any cost comparison
'Best', 'top', rankings or numbering that implies order of merit; never call November 'the best time' anywhere
Any temperature, rainfall or rain day figure not quoted from the named official source with station and period; any statistic other than sourced weather
Softening wet, monsoon or cyclone season wording beyond what the source says, or stretching it (Smartraveller says Fiji and Mauritius cyclone season starts in November, not that November is stormy)
Stating that any venue, ferry or island is closed or open in November; frame it as a venue question
Research talk (e.g. 'we analysed', 'our research', SERP references); 'free'; 'last dance'
Holiday dates of any kind (public, school, religious, US Thanksgiving), flight times, routes or visa rules
Headings with colons, dashes or hyphens, or questions outside the FAQ; em dashes anywhere
Never link /destinations/latin-america-caribbean or /destinations/africa (Smartraveller URLs with those paths are fine); no draft guides as entry links (Punta Cana held back with a LINK comment)
Copying or lightly rewording sentences from the March or August pages; competitor wording or claims; US spelling
AI images of any real destination

reserves.why_not_in: Swapped out for Hawaii: November is the coldest and least certain of the northern set (Milan is an inland city station) and lakeside villa opening in late autumn would be a question for every venue. Lake Como is in both the August and March pages, so Hawaii also makes the November set different. Swap back if the orchestrator prefers five European entries; Milan (cityId=603) is already in batch nv_a.

Guide is a draft (link map 2026-11-25). Held back with a LINK comment in 'How we chose'; add as an entry once live (WMO cityId=596 and the NHC 30 November hurricane season end are in batch nv_a/nv_b scope). The live /destination-weddings/caribbean-destination-wedding is not used as a substitute.
Late autumn fog and cold (MeteoSwiss, March pack); weakest November case.
